Issue: none of the submissions across any challenges are working on your website
Subject: Issue while taking the test
Response:
If your challenge submissions are not working, try these steps:

1. Close the challenge window and reopen it using the same challenge link.
2. Open the challenge in another supported browser, such as the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, or Edge.
3. Ensure your internet connection is stable.
4. If you're working with HTML/CSS/JavaScript or Projects questions, check your browser's cookie settings. HackerRank uses cookies for authentication, and restrictive settings may prevent submissions from working. You can add an exception for [*.]hackerrank.com in your browser's cookie settings.
5. Use the Run Code button to test your program before submitting to verify the editor is working properly.

If submissions still fail after trying these steps, contact HackerRank support at help@hackerrank.com.

Subject: How to Remove a User
Response:
To remove a user from an interview template:

1. Go to **Interviews > Templates**.
2. Click the **More options (⋮)** menu next to the template and select **Share**.
3. In the **Share Interview Template** dialog box, select the user or team you want to remove.
4. Select **Remove User** from the drop-down menu.
5. Click **Confirm** in the confirmation dialog box.

Note that only the template owner, company admins, and users or teams with editor access can share (and therefore remove users from) an interview template.

If you're trying to remove a user from the platform entirely rather than from a specific template, that functionality involves the **Modify Users** entitlement under Company settings, but the specific steps for platform-level user removal are not covered in the available documentation.

Issue: Hi, please pause our subscription. We have stopped all hiring efforts for now.
Subject: Subscription pause
Response:
The Pause Subscription feature is available only for individual self-serve monthly subscriptions (Individual Monthly - Basic or Interview Monthly). To pause your subscription, you must meet these requirements:

1. Your subscription must have been active for at least 30 days
2. You must have a monthly subscription plan (not annual)

To pause:
1. Click your profile icon in the top-right corner and select Settings
2. Navigate to Billing under Subscription
3. Click Cancel Plan
4. Select your desired pause duration from the options shown

If you have a team or enterprise subscription (HackerRank for Work), this pause feature is not available. In that case, you would need to cancel your subscription instead. To cancel, go to Manage Subscription from the profile dropdown and click Cancel Plan. You'll retain access until the end of your current billing cycle.

Issue: Claude has stopped working completely, all requests are failing
Subject: Claude not responding
Response:
There are several reasons Claude might not be responding:

**If you see "Usage limit reached":** You've hit your account usage limits. Try again later or consider upgrading your Claude plan at https://claude.ai/upgrade.

**If you see "I'm unable to generate a response at this time":** This can indicate API failures, temporary service issues, empty responses, or network connectivity problems. Try sending your message again.

**If you see "Due to unexpected capacity constraints...":** Claude's infrastructure is experiencing high demand. This is temporary and typically resolves as demand patterns shift. Wait a few minutes and try again.

**General troubleshooting steps:**
1. Check https://status.claude.com for active incidents
2. Try signing out and back into your Claude account
3. Disable any active browser extensions
4. Clear your browser's cache and cookies

If the problem persists after trying these steps, contact our Support team at https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9015913-how-to-get-support.

Issue: I want Claude to stop crawling by website
Subject: Website Data crawl
Response:
To block Claude's crawler from your website, add the following to the robots.txt file in your top-level directory:

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

You'll need to do this for every subdomain you wish to opt out from.

If you want to limit the crawling frequency rather than block it entirely, you can use the Crawl-delay extension instead:

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Crawl-delay: 1

Anthropic's bots respect industry standard directives in robots.txt and will honor these "do not crawl" signals.

Issue: I am allowing Claude to use my data to improve the models, how long will the data be used for?
Subject: Personal Data Use
Response:
When you allow Claude to use your data to improve the models, the default data retention period is 30 days. This means your inputs and outputs are automatically deleted on the backend within 30 days of receipt or generation. However, your data will be cached for a number of hours to allow you to access context in recently used sessions.

During this retention period, several privacy protections are in place:
- Your data is automatically de-linked from your user ID (like your email address) before any review
- Access is limited to a small number of personnel involved in model training
- Tools and processes are used to filter or obfuscate sensitive data
- The data is used solely to improve Claude, not for marketing, profiling, or selling to third parties

You can adjust your privacy settings at any time, and incognito chats are never used to improve Claude even if you have Model Improvement enabled.

Issue: i am a professor in a college and wanted to setup a claude lti key for my students
Subject: Claude for students
Response:
To set up Claude LTI for your students in Canvas, follow these steps:

**Creating Claude LTI Developer Key in Canvas:**

1. In Canvas, sign in as an administrator and navigate to Admin -> Developer Keys
2. Click "+ Developer Key" then "+ LTI Key"
3. Enter the following information:
   - **Key Name:** Claude LTI
   - **Description:** Enter a short description for the Canvas LTI 1.3 app
   - **Redirect URIs:** https://claude.ai/lti/launch
   - **Title:** Claude LTI
   - **Target Link URI:** https://claude.ai/lti/launch
   - **OpenID Connect Initiation Url:** https://claude.ai/api/lti/login
   - **JWK method:** https://claude.ai/api/lti/keys
4. Under **Additional Settings**, toggle Privacy Level to **Public**
5. Under **Placements**, remove the defaults and add "Course Navigation" and "Assignment Edit" as the options
6. Click "Save"
7. Toggle the state to **On**

**Installing Claude LTI as an App:**

1. In Canvas, go to Admin -> Settings -> Apps
2. Click "View App Configurations" then select "+ App"
3. Select **Configuration Type** "By Client ID"
4. Input the Client ID generated for your developer key (from the previous steps)
5. Click "Install" and refresh the course page

After completing these steps, you'll also need to turn on the Claude LTI Integration in your Claude for Education organization settings.
